integrity: Standalone Python standard-library checker and CSV certificate are included; all computations use exact integers and rationals. Outputs are same-model-reviewed mathematical results, not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns the 24 vertices of a fixed Euclidean regular truncated octahedron. It does not classify arbitrary interior-point tetrahedra or deformed cells; the known maximum-volume theorem is not claimed as new. The finite enumeration has been reproduced by separate integer-determinant, signed-symmetry-orbit and four-dimensional Gram methods, but no independent external audit has been performed. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact seventeen-level vertex-tetrahedron spectrum of the regular truncated octahedron
